line: Crowley's Queen of Disks: Hé of the Name (pdf p139); the watery part of Earth and the span from Sagittarius to Capricornus (pdf p167).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Queens (pdf p139) and on the Queen of Disks (pdf p167).

quotes.quote: The Queens represent the letter Hé of the Name.
The Queen of Disks represents the watery part of Earth, the function of that element as Mother.

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Sagittarius to the 20th degree of Capricornus (pdf p167); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: She rules from the 21st degree of Sagittarius to the 20th degree of Capricornus.
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Queen of Disks (pdf p167).

quotes.quote: She represents passivity, usually in its highest aspect.
